honors: The biggest drug lord Vice City has ever seen
Mansion, cigar, gold watch — the whole cartel aesthetic
He ruled the city, until Tommy paid a visit
back_story: Ricardo Diaz ran Vice City's cocaine empire the way he ran his mansion: loud, arrogant, and utterly convinced no one could touch him. He had men, money and a private army. But he made one mistake — he crossed Tommy Vercetti. The Rub Out hit turned the city's throne over, and the old king's cigar went cold forever.

curation.zh: 迪亚兹是罪恶城最大的毒枭，傲慢、残暴、自以为无人能撼动。可惜他惹错了人——Rub Out 一役，老毒枭的雪茄在自家庄园永远熄了。
curation.en: The drug lord who ruled Vice City with a mansion, a cigar and pure arrogance — until Tommy paid a visit.
